approval: User requested the same analysis for GPT-5.6 Sol high against Opus 5 and GPT-6, approving the same budget as the last run. New independent 500-credit ceiling; no previous unused allowance reused.
global_configuration: Same installed global profile and Superpowers v6.3.0; no routing or permission changes. Direct model override, no delegation, no Git history in sandbox.
dispatches: One fresh uninterrupted role attempt, 480-second timeout. No separate capability probe; successful role execution establishes capability. No automatic retry or continuation.
budget_control: ledger_admit checks 400 projected credits before dispatch. Wrapper monitors new completed-step costs once per second and stops at >=400 credits, leaving 100 for reporting lag. Not a provider-enforced hard cap. Interrupted in-flight charges may be unreported; orchestration/review usage is not exposed by this ledger.
checks: independent five-scenario PATH oracle at all three sites
immutable original suite against submitted installer
candidate tests against historical broken installer
independent code review including preservation of test coverage
comparison: Compare with saved Astra/Opus PATH-task totals, not tiny-fixture runs. Astra completed with a WSL test-coverage finding; Opus was budget-stopped before implementation. Those arms were interrupted/resumed and had smaller cost stops. Sol gets no solution or review feedback. This is an observational extension, not equal-budget or randomized fresh three-way trial. No general superiority or automatic routing promotion.
decision_rules: Approval pause is PROTOCOL_BLOCKED; cost/time stop or invalid environment is INCONCLUSIVE rather than coding failure. A completed submission is evaluated for requested behavior, regressions, scope and test quality. A single task can establish contender evidence, not a production default decision.
historical_bias: Historical reference fix co-authored by Opus; evaluator has seen it, candidates do not receive it. Training/prior exposure unknown.
